I specifically intend to combine these three fields of research into a variant of Ray Jackendoff's Parallel Architecture, in which the semantic-conceptual structure is unfolded into a semantic structure and a pragmatic structure. To do so, I will firstly support Jackendoff's critiques of Noam Chomsky's syntacticocentrism, adding in also critiques of Ronald Langacker's semanticocentrism, George Lakoff and Mark Johnson's metaphorocentrism as well as of Michael Tomasello's culturalism.
